newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Court upholds Commission's milk levy scheme.
newsitem.headline: Court upholds Commission's milk levy scheme.

text.p: The European Court of Justice dismissed on Thursday an attempt by the French government to annul rules fixing a flat-rate deduction on agricultural expenditures.

Noting that management of information in determining losses was not perfect, the court said "those characteristics attributable to the flat-rate element in the reductions are not sufficient to make the reduction disproportionate."

According to the court, reductions are 1 percent of the overall amount paid to a member state for the previous budget year, and are only applied to monthly advances. "The reductions do not appear to be excessive in view of the importance of due notification for the management of the milk levy scheme," the court said.
